item: BAAJA (Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act)
why_it_matters: Title III would remove the federal duty to consult tribes under NHPA Section 106
First federal statute restricting prediction-market contracts (war, terrorism, death)
Would write sports event contracts into the federal swap definition, aimed at overriding the Ninth Circuit
Replaces blanket 'gaming' prohibition with contract-by-contract review

item: CFTC interim final rule — casino-style gambling exclusion
why_it_matters: Excludes licensed casino and sportsbook wagers from the swap definition
Says exchanges generally may not block traders by location within the U.S.; does not address court-ordered exclusions from tribal lands
next_step: Exchanges must lift domestic geographic restrictions or explain to the CFTC within 30 days

item: CFTC event contract reporting final rule
why_it_matters: Replaces no-action relief dating to 2017 with permanent rules: exchanges must publish near-real-time prices, volumes and outcomes, report traders holding 125,000+ contracts in a single market, and collect customer identity, occupation and employer data
next_step: Public trade data due 60 days after Federal Register publication; large-trader reporting no earlier than July 26, 2027; customer ID in 12 months

item: State AGs' request to withdraw CFTC sports contract rule
why_it_matters: Over 40 attorneys general argue sports contracts are sports betting
First state tax on prediction market net revenue
Governor-elect Tuberville plans talks with the Poarch Creek Indians
next_step: First six months of new administration

why_it_matters: Polymarket US stops new sports contracts in Michigan and closes open positions
